questions.question: Every ability of Saitama
questions.subject: Saitama
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14. Manga-scoped, curated 'core': Saitama's page documents a large and open-ended ability set, so this lists the named combat techniques the manga attests. The two style umbrellas (Normal Series; Killer Move: Serious Series) are listed alongside their members, the same treatment hxh-set-03 gives Jajanken and its forms. Broader than opm-set-01, the closed 7-item baseline: this adds the Normal Series umbrella, Serious Side Hops, Serious Squirt Gun, Serious Sneeze, Zero Punch, Time Travel (both currently unusable, documented as such on the page) and Strong Farts (comedic but documented, ch 173). Excluded per manga scoping: webcomic-only names (Serious Headbutt, Serious Spin, Serious Whack-a-Mole, Serious Squat, Two-Handed Consecutive Normal Punches -- the page says the manga simply calls both-handed strikes Consecutive Normal Punches) and Serious Punch², which is a clash effect, not a move. No item here is a word-prefix of another despite the shared 'Serious'/'Normal' stems.

questions.question: Every ability of Genos
questions.subject: Genos
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14. Manga-scoped, curated 'core': Genos's page documents a very large ability set (named attacks plus cyborg modification features and upgrade cores), so this lists the named combat techniques the manga attests. Broader than opm-set-02, the closed 5-item baseline: it adds Maximum Gauge, Spiral, Super Spiral and True Spiral Incineration Cannon, Machine Gun Blow (the page's spelling; the baseline lists it as 'Machinegun Blows'), Boost Attack, Dual Blade Rush, Arm Lasers, Lightning Drill Cannon, Lightning Core, Tactical Combination: Promoted Rook and Self-Destruction. The Incineration Cannon family shares one name -- each variant is a separate named attack whose name contains (rather than starts with) 'Incineration Cannon' -- an intentional family relationship, not duplication. Excluded per manga scoping: webcomic-only moves (Super Incineration Cannon, High Voltage Tackle, the Scorching/Floating/Super Magnetic/Freezing/Roaring Dragon cores, Meteor Strike, Final Smash, Heat/Heavy Machine Gun Blow) and anime-only moves (Lightning Eye, High Voltage Fist). Cyborg equipment (Core, Hyper Sensors, Search Eye, Arms Mode, Instant Adhesive Gel, Arms for Chores) are body parts rather than named combat abilities and are not listed.

questions.question: Every ability of Garou
questions.subject: Garou
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14. Manga-scoped, curated 'core': Garou's page documents a very large ability set (37 named techniques across his human, monster and cosmic-fear forms), so this lists the named techniques and supernatural powers the manga attests. Broader than opm-set-03, the closed 6-item baseline: it adds Awakening Breath, Self-Styled Martial Arts, Tanktop Blow, Monster Calamity God Slayer Fist and its God Slayer Instant/Ascending Attacks, Great and Extreme Fa Jin, the cosmic-fear All Life Eradication Fist, Nuclear Fission, Nuclear Fission Gravity Knuckle, Gamma Ray Burst, Mode: Saitama and Time Travel, and the copied powers Copy Ability, Portal Creation, Gravity Manipulation and Radiation Emission. The two combined arts are spelled in the page's full 'Whirlwind Water Stream: ...' form. 'Nuclear Fission' is a deliberate word-prefix of 'Nuclear Fission Gravity Knuckle' -- separate attacks, not duplication. Excluded per manga scoping: webcomic-only absorbed techniques (Tiger Fang True Fist -- which opm-set-03 lists -- Purgatory Abyss Fist, Lake-Breaking Ice River Fist, Fool's Path Mountain Range Fist, Ultimate Fist of the Yatagarasu, Pressure Point Killer Fist, Poisonous Ogre Fist, Lone Fist of Prosperity, Fire Dance Bullet Trail Fist, Tanktop Tackle) and the Saitama moves Garou only uses via Mode: Saitama (Consecutive Normal Punches, Serious Punch), which are Saitama's techniques rather than his own. Forms (Cosmic Fear Mode) and generic physical descriptors are not abilities.

answer.item: Whirlwind Water Stream: Roaring Aura Sky Ripping Fist
Whirlwind Water Stream: Cross Fang Dragon Slayer Fist

Psychic Whirlwind is excluded because the page describes it only via webcomic evidence ('In the webcomic, by making her psychic signals move in circles...') and the question is manga-scoped.
